basis: SunPower’s November 1 preliminary Q3 results first established the decline. Its consolidated GAAP statements reported $432,000,000 in total revenue for the three months ended October 1, 2023, versus $476,250,000 for the three months ended October 2, 2022. That was a 9.29% decline and below the contemporaneous 95% threshold of $452,437,500. Both quarters excluded discontinued C&I Solutions operations. The later Form 10-Q confirmed the decline using revised amounts.

coverage.detail: May 3, preceding earnings cycle. The Q1 release affirmed full-year guidance of 90,000–110,000 incremental customers and $125–155 million of adjusted EBITDA. It gave no Q3 consolidated revenue range.
July 26 preliminary update. The $464 million revenue figure covered Q2, which ended July 2. Management cut annual customer and earnings guidance without quantifying Q3 revenue.

August 1 Q2 results. SunPower disclosed a Q3 opening backlog of 20,000 retrofit and 39,000 New Homes customers. Its outlook repeated full-year targets of 70,000–90,000 incremental customers and $55–75 million of adjusted EBITDA. Neither metric established Q3 GAAP sales.

August 1 public call, management remarks transcribed by The Motley Fool. In discussing slides 11–12, management said California lease revenue recognition had shifted into Q3 and quantified the Q2 EBITDA effect at about $7 million. It gave no ceiling for total Q3 revenue.

SunPower’s release archive covers the interval after Q2 results. August 11 addressed a supply negotiation, September 6–7 covered grants and battery storage, and September 21 announced the November 1 earnings call. None supplied a Q3 consolidated revenue figure.
September 13 Form 8-K disclosed the principal accounting officer’s resignation. It gave no sales update.
October 24 Form 8-K described an estimated $16–20 million inventory overstatement affecting cost of revenue in earlier periods. It gave no Q3 sales figure.
October 31 issuer announcement concerned agreements with four homebuilders. It supplied no consolidated Q3 revenue amount or range.
November 1 preliminary results. The quarterly GAAP total-revenues row, in thousands, shows 432,000 versus 476,250. This is the first qualifying point amount.

December 18 Form 10-Q. The consolidated quarterly total-revenues row, in thousands, shows 430,690 versus 476,393 as restated. The final 95% threshold was $452,573,350, also above the preliminary amount.

publication_date_evidence: The SEC exhibit is datelined November 1, 2023. SunPower’s original wire release identifies SunPower Corp. as the provider and records publication at 07:45 ET that day, before the 08:00 ET earnings call. https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sunpower-reports-preliminary-third-quarter-2023-results-301973688.html
